source: Transcribed on 2026-11-17 from eval/README.md (results table and holdout sets, threshold 50, score model v1) and docs/scoring.md (holdout at thresholds 30 and 70, v1 columns); not written by a run. The Wilson bounds are recomputed from the published counts with wilson() in eval/run_eval.py; the documents print them in whole percent. Left out because those documents do not give them: dev at thresholds 30 and 70, the two holdout sets at thresholds 30 and 70, error counts other than the 5 pypi_malregistry archives that do not unpack, and the sets dev/tune-2026-11, dev/fit-2026-11, dev/random-2026-11 and holdout/random-2026-11. No score_model field: the published run used the default model (v1).
